verdict.rationale: Factory documents an official Droid SDK that runs the same agent harness behind its CLI, desktop app and web platform from your own code. A TypeScript SDK page exists, and a sessions API reference plus a published OpenAPI spec support programmatic building. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, detailed SDK API/usage documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Droid SDK lets you run the same agent harness that powers Factory's CLI, desktop application, and web platform from your own code.
Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.
